evals.name: long-and-short-horizon-plan
evals.prompt: Help me plan the next quarter for the manuscript and choose what to focus on next week. Fixture: outcome is a submitted manuscript draft; Milestone M1 has a methods draft task blocked on data; M2 has a figure revision ready; no capacity estimate or weekly commitment is recorded. Return a proposal in chat only, no writes or calendar placement.
evals.expected_output: Separate quarterly outcome and milestones from a finite weekly candidate. Preserve blocked work, flag missing capacity and commitment, recommend the ready figure work only as a candidate, and make no changes.
expectations: Distinguishes long-term outcome from next-week candidate work.
Does not treat blocked tasks, missing capacity or absence of an agreement as a settled commitment.
Returns the proposal in chat with no local HTML or source writes.

evals.name: calendar-near-miss
evals.prompt: Put the ready figure revision on Tuesday from 10 to 11 and check whether it conflicts with my existing events. Do not change anything yet.
evals.expected_output: Recognize this as Calendar scheduling and conflict work, not planning; hand off the target and requested week/time while preserving the no-change instruction.
expectations: Routes time placement and conflict inspection to Calendar.
Does not silently create or move events.
Preserves the user's instruction to make no changes.
